materials.article_markdown:
## Mengapa Passive Voice Penting di IELTS?

Pada IELTS Writing Task 1 versi Academic, kamu kadang diminta menjelaskan sebuah proses: bagaimana kakao menjadi cokelat, bagaimana air limbah dibersihkan, atau bagaimana kertas didaur ulang. Dalam gambar proses seperti itu, yang penting adalah tahapannya, bukan siapa yang mengerjakannya. Kalau kamu menulis *Workers pick the beans. Workers dry the beans. Workers sort the beans.* tiga kali berturut-turut, tulisanmu terdengar monoton dan terlalu fokus pada pelaku. Dengan passive voice, kalimat bergeser ke benda yang diproses: *The beans are picked, dried and sorted.*

Passive voice juga sering muncul di teks Reading ilmiah dan di kuliah Listening Section 4. Kalau kamu mengenali bentuknya dengan cepat, kamu tidak akan tersesat ketika subjek kalimat ternyata bukan pelaku tindakan.

## Konsep Dasar: Objek Naik Menjadi Subjek

Dalam kalimat aktif, pelaku berada di depan: *The factory produces thousands of bottles every day.* Dalam kalimat pasif, benda yang dikenai tindakan berpindah ke depan: *Thousands of bottles are produced every day.* Pelaku boleh dibuang, atau diletakkan di belakang dengan *by*.

Rumus umumnya selalu sama: **subjek + be (sesuai tense) + verb bentuk ketiga (V3)**. Yang berubah hanyalah bentuk *be*.

| Tense | Rumus pasif | Contoh dalam konteks proses |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Present Simple | `am / is / are + V3` | *The milk is heated to 72 degrees.* |
| Past Simple | `was / were + V3` | *The first samples were tested in 2019.* |
| Present Perfect | `has / have been + V3` | *Once the glass has been cooled, it is cut.* |
| Future (will) | `will be + V3` | *The results will be published next month.* |
| Modal | `can / must / should be + V3` | *Waste water must be treated before release.* |

Perhatikan bahwa pada modal, kata *be* tidak berubah menjadi *is* atau *are*. Bentuknya tetap *be*, karena kata kerja setelah modal selalu berbentuk dasar.

## Kapan Passive Voice Dipakai?

Ada tiga situasi yang paling berguna untuk IELTS.

1. **Pelaku tidak penting atau sudah jelas.** *The road was closed for repairs.* Kita tidak perlu tahu siapa yang menutupnya.
2. **Pelaku tidak diketahui.** *My bicycle was stolen last night.*
3. **Fokus pada proses atau hasil.** *The bricks are baked in a kiln at 1,000 degrees.* Kamu menjelaskan tahap, bukan orang.

Gunakan *by + pelaku* hanya bila pelaku membawa informasi penting, misalnya *The theory was proposed by a team of Australian biologists.* Bila kamu menulis *by people* atau *by someone*, frasa itu hampir selalu bisa dihapus.

:::tips-examiner
Pada Task 1 gambar proses, penguji mencari variasi struktur kalimat, bukan sekadar pasif di setiap kalimat. Campurkan pasif dengan kata urutan seperti *First*, *Next*, *After that*, dan *Finally*, serta sesekali gunakan klausa waktu seperti *Once the leaves have been dried, they are packed.* Satu paragraf proses dengan lima sampai tujuh pasif yang akurat jauh lebih meyakinkan daripada sepuluh kalimat pasif yang sebagian salah bentuk.
:::

## Cara Membentuk Kalimat Pasif Langkah demi Langkah

Ambil kalimat aktif: *Farmers harvest the grapes in September.*

1. Cari objek: *the grapes*. Objek ini akan menjadi subjek baru.
2. Tentukan tense kalimat aktif: *harvest* adalah Present Simple.
3. Pilih bentuk *be* yang cocok dengan subjek baru: *the grapes* jamak, jadi *are*.
4. Ubah kata kerja utama ke V3: *harvested*.
5. Pelaku (*farmers*) dibuang atau dipindah ke belakang: *The grapes are harvested in September.*

Untuk tense yang lebih rumit, caranya sama. *Engineers have repaired the bridge* menjadi *The bridge has been repaired* karena subjek baru tunggal dan tensenya Present Perfect.

## Verb-3 Tidak Beraturan yang Sering Muncul

Banyak kesalahan pasif sebenarnya adalah kesalahan V3. Hafalkan kelompok yang paling sering muncul dalam deskripsi proses.

| Bentuk dasar | Past Simple | V3 (dipakai di pasif) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| grind | ground | ground |
| build | built | built |
| mix | mixed | mixed |
| send | sent | sent |
| hold | held | held |
| cut | cut | cut |
| break | broke | broken |
| choose | chose | chosen |
| take | took | taken |
| write | wrote | written |

Kata kerja beraturan cukup ditambah *-ed*: *heated*, *sorted*, *packed*. Ingat bahwa *cut* tidak berubah bentuk sama sekali, sehingga *The wood is cut into planks* sudah benar.

## Contoh Paragraf Proses

Bandingkan dua versi berikut. Versi pertama hanya memakai kalimat aktif dengan pelaku yang sama.

> Workers collect the plastic bottles. Then they wash the bottles. After that, they cut the bottles into small pieces.

Versi kedua memakai pasif dan kata urutan.

> First, the plastic bottles are collected. Next, they are washed in hot water. After that, they are cut into small pieces, which are later melted and shaped into new containers.

Versi kedua terdengar seperti laporan ilmiah, dan itulah register yang diharapkan di Task 1.

:::kesalahan-umum
Tiga kesalahan yang paling sering muncul pada tulisan kandidat:

1. **Lupa be.** *The beans dried in the sun* (salah, maknanya jadi aktif) harus menjadi *The beans are dried in the sun.*
2. **Memakai V2 atau bentuk dasar sebagai pengganti V3.** *The wheat is grind* dan *The cake was bake* salah. Yang benar: *is ground* dan *was baked*.
3. **Memasang pasif pada kata kerja intransitif.** Kata seperti *happen*, *occur*, *arrive*, dan *rise* tidak punya objek, sehingga tidak bisa dipasifkan. *The accident was happened* selalu salah; yang benar adalah *The accident happened.*
:::

## Pasif dengan Dua Objek dan Pasif Ringkas

Beberapa kata kerja, seperti *give*, *send*, dan *show*, punya dua objek. Kamu boleh menaikkan salah satunya: *The students were given a short test*, atau *A short test was given to the students.* Untuk tulisan akademik, bentuk pertama lebih umum karena terdengar lebih alami.

Dalam laporan, kamu juga akan melihat pasif ringkas setelah kata benda: *The samples collected from the river were tested.* Frasa *collected from the river* adalah pasif yang dipadatkan dari *which were collected from the river*. Kemampuan memakai bentuk ini adalah tanda tata bahasa yang lebih matang, tetapi baru dipakai setelah bentuk dasar di atas terasa otomatis.

## Latihan Mandiri Sebelum Drill

Coba ubah tiga kalimat berikut menjadi pasif tanpa melihat rumus, lalu periksa jawabanmu di bagian bawah.

1. The company exports tea to forty countries.
2. Scientists have discovered a new species of frog.
3. The city council will build a new library next year.

Jawaban: (1) *Tea is exported to forty countries.* (2) *A new species of frog has been discovered.* (3) *A new library will be built next year.*

## Ringkasan

- Pasif dibentuk dengan **be + V3**, dan tense ditentukan oleh bentuk *be*.
- Pakai pasif saat pelaku tidak penting, tidak diketahui, atau saat kamu menjelaskan proses.
- Hafalkan V3 tidak beraturan yang sering muncul, dan jangan memasifkan kata kerja intransitif.
- Variasikan pasif dengan kata urutan agar paragraf proses terdengar alami.

Setelah materi ini, kerjakan Active Drill berisi 10 soal, lalu tulis paragraf pendek di bagian Terapkan.

mini_task.prompt:
Ubah empat tahapan aktif berikut menjadi satu paragraf pasif (sekitar 50-70 kata) memakai kata penghubung First, Next, After that, dan Finally:
1. Farmers pick the cocoa pods.
2. Workers remove the beans and dry them in the sun.
3. A machine roasts and grinds the beans.
4. The factory mixes the paste with sugar and pours it into moulds.
mini_task.ai_rubric_criteria: Paragraf harus memuat empat kalimat pasif Present Simple yang akurat (misalnya 'are picked', 'are removed/dried', 'are roasted/ground', 'is mixed/poured'), memakai keempat kata penghubung urutan dengan tepat, tidak memakai pelaku aktif berulang, dan V3 tidak beraturan ditulis benar (ground).

questions.prompt:
Lengkapi kalimat berikut dengan bentuk pasif dari kata di dalam kurung:
'Once the grapes _______ (harvest), they are taken to the factory.'
questions.explanation_id: Kalimat memakai 'Once ... , they are taken', yaitu rangkaian proses. Tindakan memanen sudah selesai sebelum pengangkutan, sehingga dipakai Present Perfect Passive: has/have been + V3. Subjek 'the grapes' jamak, jadi 'have been harvested'.

questions.prompt:
Lengkapi dengan bentuk pasif Present Simple:
'The final product _______ (sell) in supermarkets across the country.'
questions.explanation_id: Ini fakta umum tentang proses, sehingga Present Simple. Subjek 'the final product' tunggal, jadi 'is'. V3 dari 'sell' adalah 'sold' (tidak beraturan), bukan 'selled'.

questions.prompt:
Lengkapi dengan pasif modal (gunakan 'must'):
'Waste water _______ (treat) before it is released into the river.'
questions.explanation_id: Pasif modal dibentuk modal + be + V3. Setelah 'must' kata kerja berbentuk dasar, jadi 'be' (bukan 'is'), lalu 'treated'.

questions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang paling tepat untuk laporan akademik tentang proses pembuatan kopi?
options: People grind the coffee beans in a machine.
The coffee beans are ground in a mechanical grinder.
The coffee beans is ground in a machine.
The coffee beans are grind in a machine.
correct_answers: The coffee beans are ground in a mechanical grinder.
questions.explanation_id: Pilihan B memakai pasif yang benar: 'beans' jamak + 'are' + V3 'ground'. Pilihan A bersifat aktif dengan pelaku yang tidak penting. Pilihan C salah kesesuaian subjek-be ('beans ... is'). Pilihan D memakai bentuk dasar 'grind', bukan V3.

questions.prompt: Pilih bentuk pasif yang benar dari kalimat: 'Engineers have repaired the bridge.'
options: The bridge has been repaired by engineers.
The bridge was repaired by engineers.
The bridge has repaired by engineers.
The bridge have been repaired by engineers.
correct_answers: The bridge has been repaired by engineers.
questions.explanation_id: Kalimat aktif memakai Present Perfect, maka pasifnya has/have been + V3. Subjek baru 'the bridge' tunggal, jadi 'has been repaired'.

questions.prompt: Pada kalimat mana frasa 'by + pelaku' sebaiknya dihapus karena tidak memberi informasi baru?
options: The painting was created by Leonardo da Vinci.
The samples were tested by people.
The report was written by a team from the national statistics office.
The theory was proposed by two Australian biologists.
correct_answers: The samples were tested by people.
questions.explanation_id: 'By people' tidak memberi informasi karena pengujian tentu dilakukan oleh orang.

questions.prompt: Pilih jawaban yang benar: 'The recycled paper can _______ into new boxes.'
questions.explanation_id: Pasif modal: modal + be + V3. Setelah 'can' dipakai 'be', lalu 'turned'.

questions.prompt: Susun segmen berikut menjadi kalimat pasif yang benar tentang proses pasteurisasi susu.
questions.explanation_id: Urutan yang benar: subjek (The raw milk), be (is) dengan kata urutan 'first', kata kerja V3 beserta keterangan (heated to 72 degrees), lalu bagian akhir (and then cooled quickly).

questions.prompt: Pilih satu kata yang membuat kalimat pasif ini salah.
questions.explanation_id: Setelah 'is' dibutuhkan V3, yaitu 'mixed'. 'Mix' adalah bentuk dasar.

questions.prompt: Pasangkan setiap kalimat aktif dengan kalimat pasif yang tepat.

left: Workers pick the tea leaves by hand.
Scientists have developed a new vaccine.
The council will close the road next week.
right: The road will be closed next week.
Tea leaves are picked by hand.
A new vaccine has been developed.

questions.explanation_id: Samakan tense: Present Simple -> 'are picked', Past Simple -> 'was stolen', Present Perfect -> 'has been developed', Future -> 'will be closed'.

questions.prompt:
Lengkapi kalimat berikut dengan bentuk pasif dari kata di dalam kurung:
'After the cocoa pods _______ (collect), the beans are extracted.'
questions.explanation_id: Urutan proses: pemanenan selesai sebelum ekstraksi biji, memakai Present Perfect Passive 'have been collected' karena subjek 'the cocoa pods' jamak.

questions.prompt:
Lengkapi dengan bentuk pasif Present Simple:
'The raw tea leaves _______ (dry) on large wooden trays in the sun.'
questions.explanation_id: Fakta proses rutin memakai Present Simple Passive. Subjek jamak 'tea leaves' memakai 'are', dan V3 dari dry adalah 'dried'.

questions.prompt:
Lengkapi dengan pasif modal (gunakan 'should'):
'Hazardous chemicals _______ (store) in a dedicated temperature-controlled room.'
questions.explanation_id: Pasif modal: modal + be + V3 -> 'should be stored'.

questions.prompt: Manakah kalimat pasif yang paling sesuai untuk mendeskripsikan tahap pengemasan madu?
options: They put the liquid honey in sterilized glass jars.
The liquid honey is poured into sterilized glass jars.
Honey pour into sterilized glass jars.
The honey is pouring into jars by them.
correct_answers: The liquid honey is poured into sterilized glass jars.
questions.explanation_id: Pilihan B menggunakan kalimat pasif ilmiah objektif yang baku ('is poured'). Pilihan A menggunakan aktif informal ('they'), C salah tata bahasa, D present continuous pasif yang janggal.

questions.prompt: Pilih bentuk pasif yang benar dari kalimat: 'Researchers have discovered a new marine species.'
options: A new marine species has been discovered by researchers.
A new marine species was discovered by researchers.
A new marine species has discovered by researchers.
A new marine species had been discovered by researchers.
correct_answers: A new marine species has been discovered by researchers.
questions.explanation_id: Present perfect aktif ('have discovered') menjadi present perfect pasif ('has been discovered') menyesuaikan subjek tunggal 'a new marine species'.

questions.prompt: Pada kalimat mana frasa 'by + pelaku' sebaiknya dihapus dalam penulisan ilmiah?
options: The theory of relativity was formulated by Albert Einstein.
The laboratory equipment was cleaned by workers.
The novel was illustrated by a local artist.
The historical document was signed by King John.
correct_answers: The laboratory equipment was cleaned by workers.
questions.explanation_id: 'By workers' tidak memberikan informasi baru karena pembersihan lab lumrah dilakukan oleh staf/pekerja.

questions.prompt: Pilih jawaban yang benar: 'All submitted essays must _______ by the end of this semester.'
questions.explanation_id: Pasif modal: must + be + V3 -> 'be completed'.

questions.prompt: Susun segmen berikut menjadi kalimat pasif yang tepat tentang pengolahan air limbah.
questions.explanation_id: Urutan yang benar: Subjek (The contaminated water) + be (is) + adverb (thoroughly) + V3 (filtered through carbon beds) + adverbial clause (before chemical disinfection).

questions.prompt: Pilih satu kata yang membuat kalimat pasif ini salah.
questions.explanation_id: Kata 'extract' setelah 'is' harus berupa bentuk V3 yaitu 'extracted'.

questions.prompt: Pasangkan setiap kalimat aktif berikut dengan padanan pasifnya yang tepat.

left: Technicians calibrate the sensors every morning.
A local contractor built the greenhouse in 2020.
The committee has approved the revised budget.
The university will host the international symposium next month.
right: The international symposium will be hosted by the university next month.
The greenhouse was built by a local contractor in 2020.
The sensors are calibrated every morning.
The revised budget has been approved by the committee.
The sensors were calibrated every morning.

questions.explanation_id: Samakan tenses dengan presisi: Present Simple -> are calibrated, Past Simple -> was built, Present Perfect -> has been approved, Future -> will be hosted.

questions.prompt:
Lengkapi kalimat berikut dengan bentuk pasif dari kata di dalam kurung:
'When the metal sheets _______ (cut) to the specified dimensions, they are welded together.'
questions.explanation_id: Urutan proses: pemotongan lembaran logam selesai terlebih dahulu memakai Present Perfect Passive 'have been cut' (V3 dari cut adalah cut).

questions.prompt:
Lengkapi dengan bentuk pasif Present Simple:
'Purified water _______ (distribute) through underground pipelines to residential areas.'
questions.explanation_id: Fakta proses distribusi air memakai Present Simple Passive. Subjek 'purified water' tidak dapat dihitung (tunggal) sehingga memakai 'is distributed'.

questions.prompt:
Lengkapi dengan pasif modal (gunakan 'may'):
'Excess heat _______ (use) to generate electricity for the local community.'
questions.explanation_id: Pasif modal: may + be + V3 -> 'may be used'.

questions.prompt: Manakah kalimat pasif yang paling tepat untuk laporan siklus daur ulang botol kaca?
options: People sort the glass bottles by color manually.
The glass bottles are separated by color before melting.
Bottles separate by color in a factory.
They are separating glass bottles by color.
correct_answers: The glass bottles are separated by color before melting.
questions.explanation_id: Pilihan B adalah kalimat pasif formal yang tepat untuk laporan diagram alir IELTS Task 1.

questions.prompt: Pilih bentuk pasif yang benar dari kalimat: 'The municipality has installed solar panels on all public schools.'
options: Solar panels have been installed on all public schools by the municipality.
Solar panels were installed on all public schools.
Solar panels has been installed on all public schools.
Solar panels had been installed on all public schools.
correct_answers: Solar panels have been installed on all public schools by the municipality.
questions.explanation_id: Present perfect aktif ('has installed') menjadi present perfect pasif jamak ('have been installed') menyesuaikan subjek baru 'solar panels'.

questions.prompt: Pada kalimat mana frasa 'by + pelaku' sebaiknya dihapus agar kalimat lebih padat dan formal?
options: The symphony was composed by Ludwig van Beethoven.
The patient data was recorded by individuals.
The survey was conducted by the national statistics bureau.
The architecture was designed by Zaha Hadid.
correct_answers: The patient data was recorded by individuals.
questions.explanation_id: 'By individuals' adalah frasa umum yang tidak memberi kontribusi informasi bermakna.

questions.prompt: Pilih jawaban yang benar: 'Important scientific findings will _______ at the upcoming conference.'
questions.explanation_id: Pasif future modal: will + be + V3 -> 'be presented'.

questions.prompt: Susun segmen berikut menjadi kalimat pasif yang runtut mengenai proses pembuatan kertas daur ulang.
questions.explanation_id: Urutan yang benar: Subjek (The waste paper) + be + V3 (is shredded) + klausa gabungan (and mixed with warm water) + keterangan tujuan (to create pulp).

questions.prompt: Pilih satu kata yang membuat kalimat pasif ini salah.
questions.explanation_id: Kata 'transport' setelah auxiliary 'is' harus berupa V3 yaitu 'transported'.

questions.prompt: Pasangkan kalimat aktif berikut dengan transformasi pasif yang tepat.

left: Farmers harvest the olives in late autumn.
The laboratory synthesized the compound last year.
The government has declared a state of emergency.
Volunteers will clean the coastal area tomorrow.
right: The coastal area will be cleaned by volunteers tomorrow.
The compound was synthesized by the laboratory last year.
The olives are harvested in late autumn.
A state of emergency has been declared by the government.
The olives were harvested in late autumn.

questions.explanation_id: Present Simple -> are harvested, Past Simple -> was synthesized, Present Perfect -> has been declared, Future -> will be cleaned.

materials.article_markdown:
## Listening Section 1: Melengkapi Formulir dan Menjawab dengan Tepat

Section 1 IELTS Listening biasanya berupa percakapan sehari-hari antara dua orang, misalnya mendaftar kursus atau memesan tempat. Tugas yang paling sering muncul adalah **form completion** (melengkapi formulir), pilihan ganda, dan pelabelan denah. Audio hanya diputar satu kali, sehingga persiapan sebelum audio mulai sangat menentukan.

### Sebelum Audio Diputar

Gunakan waktu membaca untuk memprediksi jenis jawaban. Lihat kata di sebelum dan sesudah kolom kosong.

| Petunjuk di formulir | Jenis jawaban yang diprediksi |
| :--- | :--- |
| Surname: ______ | Nama keluarga, kemungkinan dieja huruf demi huruf |
| Start date: ______ | Tanggal atau bulan |
| Fee: £ ______ | Angka |
| Bring: ______ | Kata benda (benda yang dibawa) |

Perhatikan juga batas kata. Bila soal berbunyi *NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS*, jawaban dengan tiga kata dianggap salah, walaupun isinya benar.

### Mengenali Koreksi Pembicara

Penutur Section 1 sering mengoreksi dirinya. Contoh: *The class starts at six thirty... oh, sorry, it changed. It starts at seven now.* Jawabannya adalah waktu yang terakhir. Latih telingamu pada kata penanda koreksi seperti *actually*, *sorry*, *I mean*, dan *no, wait*.

### Ejaan dan Angka

Nama diucapkan huruf demi huruf. Kuasai pelafalan alfabet Inggris, terutama pasangan yang mirip seperti *A* dan *E*, *G* dan *J*, serta *I* dan *Y*. Untuk angka, bedakan *thirteen* dan *thirty* lewat tekanan kata: *thirTEEN* versus *THIRty*.

:::tips-examiner
Tulis jawaban dengan ejaan yang benar. Satu huruf salah pada nama atau kata benda membuat jawaban tidak diberi nilai. Bila pembicara memberi ejaan huruf demi huruf, gunakan itu sebagai acuan, bukan tebakanmu dari bunyi kata.
:::

:::kesalahan-umum
1. Menulis jawaban pertama yang terdengar tanpa menunggu koreksi pembicara.
2. Melewati batas kata, misalnya menulis *the watercolour class* padahal formulir hanya memberi satu kata kosong.
3. Terpaku pada satu soal yang terlewat, lalu kehilangan soal-soal berikutnya. Lepaskan, lanjutkan, dan kembali bila ada waktu.
:::

Latihan di bawah memakai satu rekaman percakapan pendaftaran kursus. Dengarkan sekali, lalu jawab setiap soal.

mini_task.prompt: Dengarkan ulang rekaman latihan (setelah selesai) dan catat dua kata penanda koreksi yang kamu dengar. Tuliskan pula satu soal yang kamu jawab salah karena terburu-buru menulis jawaban pertama.
mini_task.ai_rubric_criteria: Centang mandiri: (a) kamu menemukan minimal dua penanda koreksi; (b) kamu menuliskan jawaban akhir, bukan jawaban sementara; (c) ejaan nama dan kata benda sudah diperiksa.

questions.prompt:
Lengkapi formulir pendaftaran.
Surname: _______
questions.explanation_id: Penelepon mengeja nama keluarganya: B-R-A-N-N-I-G-A-N. Ejaan harus tepat.

questions.prompt: Course: _______ painting for beginners
questions.explanation_id: Penelepon memilih 'watercolour painting'. Ejaan UK dan US diterima.

questions.prompt: Start date: Tuesday, 14th _______
questions.explanation_id: Staf menyebut 'Tuesday the fourteenth of October'.

questions.prompt: Fee for the whole term: £ _______
questions.explanation_id: Staf menyebut 'eighty-five pounds for the whole term'.

questions.prompt: Students should bring their own _______
questions.explanation_id: Staf berkata 'Just an apron'. Penelepon menegaskan 'I'll bring my own'.

questions.prompt: Why does Daniel want to join the course?
options: He wants to meet other people.
He wants to learn proper techniques after practising alone.
He needs a qualification for his job.
He wants to find a teacher for his children.
correct_answers: He wants to learn proper techniques after practising alone.
questions.explanation_id: Daniel sudah melukis sendiri di rumah dan ingin 'learn the proper techniques from a real teacher'.

questions.prompt: What time does the class start now?
questions.explanation_id: Poster menyebut 6:30, tetapi staf mengoreksi bahwa jadwal dipindah menjadi pukul 7:00.

questions.prompt: Where will the class be held this term?
questions.explanation_id: Room Four sedang dicat ulang sehingga kelas dipindah ke Garden Studio.

questions.prompt: Sesuai penjelasan staf, di mana letak setiap fasilitas? Seret jawaban ke tempat yang benar.

right: Next to the main entrance, on the left
At the end of the side path
In a glass building in the garden
Opposite the stairs on the first floor

questions.explanation_id: Kafe di sebelah pintu masuk utama (kiri); cloakroom di belakang meja resepsionis; car park di ujung side path; Garden Studio di taman.

questions.prompt: Apa yang harus ditunjukkan Daniel di meja resepsionis pada hari pertama? (Maksimal TIGA kata)
questions.explanation_id: Staf meminta menunjukkan confirmation email kepada petugas resepsionis.

sub_modules.sub_module_title: Taktik True / False / Not Given & Yes / No / Not Given

materials.article_markdown:
## Taktik True / False / Not Given

Soal True / False / Not Given (TFNG) menguji apakah kamu dapat membandingkan sebuah pernyataan dengan isi teks, bukan dengan pengetahuanmu sendiri. Kesalahan terbesar kandidat adalah menjawab berdasarkan apa yang menurutnya benar di dunia nyata. Aturan emasnya: **hanya teks yang berhak menentukan jawaban.**

### Tiga Jawaban, Tiga Pertanyaan

| Jawaban | Arti | Pertanyaan yang kamu ajukan |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **True** | Teks menyatakan hal yang sama dengan pernyataan | Apakah ada kalimat yang maknanya sama? |
| **False** | Teks menyatakan hal yang berlawanan | Apakah ada kalimat yang bertentangan langsung? |
| **Not Given** | Teks tidak membahas hal itu, atau tidak cukup rinci | Setelah membaca semua bagian terkait, apakah informasinya tetap tidak ada? |

Contoh singkat. Misalkan teks berbunyi: *The survey covered twelve roofs during three summers.*

- *The survey lasted for three years.* adalah **False**: teks menyebut tiga musim panas, bukan tiga tahun penuh, dan jumlahnya tidak cocok dengan pernyataan.
- *The survey covered twelve roofs.* adalah **True**.
- *The survey was paid for by the city council.* adalah **Not Given**: teks tidak pernah menyebut siapa yang membiayai.

### Langkah Kerja

1. Garis bawahi kata kunci dalam pernyataan: angka, kata sifat, kata kuantitas (*all*, *most*, *some*), dan kata penghubung.
2. Cari kalimat terkait di teks. Soal TFNG hampir selalu mengikuti urutan teks.
3. Bandingkan makna, bukan kata yang sama. Teks sering memakai sinonim.
4. Putuskan dengan tiga pertanyaan di tabel di atas.

:::tips-examiner
Perhatikan kata pembatas seperti *all*, *always*, *never*, *only*, dan *most*. Bila pernyataan berkata *all farms* tetapi teks hanya menyebut *several farms*, kamu biasanya tidak boleh menjawab True. Perbedaan antara *some* dan *most* sering menjadi penentu antara True dan Not Given.
:::

:::kesalahan-umum
1. Menjawab **False** saat teks diam. Bila tidak ada kalimat yang berlawanan, jawabannya Not Given.
2. Menjawab **True** karena pernyataan masuk akal menurut pengetahuan umum.
3. Berhenti membaca setelah menemukan satu kata kunci yang cocok. Baca sampai akhir kalimat, karena kata *however* atau *but* sering membalik maknanya.
:::

Setelah membaca materi ini, kerjakan latihan: satu bacaan orisinal tentang pertanian atap kota dengan sepuluh soal berbagai tipe.

mini_task.prompt: Ambil tiga pernyataan dari latihan ini yang kamu jawab Not Given atau False. Untuk masing-masing, tulis (1) kalimat teks yang kamu jadikan dasar, dan (2) satu kalimat alasan kenapa itu bukan True.
mini_task.ai_rubric_criteria: Centang mandiri: (a) kamu menunjuk kalimat teks, bukan pengetahuan umum; (b) kamu dapat membedakan teks yang bertentangan (False) dari teks yang diam (Not Given); (c) kamu memeriksa kata pembatas seperti all, most, only.

active_drill.reading_passage_markdown:
## The Quiet Revival of Rooftop Farming

[A] For most of the twentieth century, the flat roofs of city buildings were treated as wasted space. They held water tanks, ventilation units and little else. In recent years, however, a growing number of building owners have started to see them differently. Across many cities, roofs are being covered with soil, planted with vegetables and herbs, and managed as small farms. The movement, usually called rooftop farming, has attracted enthusiasts, investors and, increasingly, researchers who want to know whether it really delivers the benefits its supporters claim.

[B] One of the earliest systematic studies was carried out by a team at the Harbour Institute of Urban Studies. Over three summers, the researchers measured temperatures on twelve roofs, six of them planted and six left bare. On the hottest afternoons, the surface of the bare roofs reached up to 62 degrees Celsius, while the planted roofs stayed at around 34 degrees. Rooms on the top floors beneath the planted roofs were, on average, four degrees cooler, and the tenants in those rooms used air conditioning far less often. The team cautioned, however, that the effect depended heavily on the depth of the soil and on regular watering. A thin layer of dry earth, they found, did almost nothing.

[C] Food production is the second benefit usually claimed for rooftop farms. A typical commercial roof farm in the study area, covering about 400 square metres, produced between 2,000 and 3,000 kilograms of salad leaves, tomatoes and herbs each year. This is a small amount compared with a conventional farm, and nobody involved in the study suggested that roofs could feed a city. The produce does have one clear advantage, though. It can be delivered to nearby restaurants and shops within hours of harvest, which reduces transport costs and the amount of food that spoils on the way.

[D] Water is a more complicated matter. Planted roofs absorb rainwater that would otherwise rush into the drains, and during heavy storms this slows the flow into the sewage system. In the Harbour Institute study, planted roofs held back around 60 percent of the rain that fell in an average storm, which meant that the drains below were less likely to overflow. Yet the gardens themselves need irrigation in dry months, and several of the early projects relied entirely on mains water. Later farms installed tanks that collect rainwater in winter and release it slowly in summer, a change that reduced their use of mains water by roughly half.

[E] Cost is the main obstacle to wider adoption. Strengthening an old roof so that it can carry the weight of wet soil can cost more than the garden itself, and many buildings constructed before the 1970s simply cannot be adapted. For this reason, most successful projects so far have been on newer office blocks or on buildings that were designed with a planted roof in mind. Some city councils have offered tax reductions to owners who install planted roofs, but the researchers found no evidence that such incentives, on their own, persuaded owners who were unsure about the idea. Owners who did go ahead were usually motivated by lower energy bills or by the wish to make their building stand out to tenants.

[F] The social benefits of roof farms are harder to measure, although they are mentioned often. Volunteers at three of the farms said that they had made new friends among their neighbours, and a nearby primary school now brings a class of pupils to one roof each month to learn how vegetables grow. The researchers pointed out, however, that these accounts came from people who had chosen to take part, so they may not represent the views of everyone who lives near a roof farm. A neighbour who is bothered by noise from the weekend work sessions, for example, was unlikely to volunteer an opinion.

[G] The authors conclude that rooftop farming is neither a miracle nor a fashion that will soon pass. It is most convincing as a way of cooling buildings and managing rainwater, and less convincing as a source of food. They recommend that future studies follow roofs for at least ten years, because none of the farms in their sample had existed for longer than five. Until that evidence is available, they suggest, cities should support new projects but avoid promising residents more than the data can show.

questions.prompt: On the hottest afternoons, the surface of the bare roofs was hotter than the surface of the planted roofs.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf B: bare roofs mencapai hingga 62 derajat, sedangkan planted roofs sekitar 34 derajat. Pernyataan sesuai dengan teks.

questions.prompt: The researchers measured roof temperatures over a period of five years.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf B menyebut 'over three summers'. Lima tahun muncul di paragraf G untuk usia farm tertua, bukan lama pengukuran.

questions.prompt: The researchers believe that rooftop farms could supply most of the vegetables a city needs.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf C: 'nobody involved in the study suggested that roofs could feed a city'. Teks bertentangan langsung.

questions.prompt: Planted roofs held back more than half of the rain that fell in an average storm.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf D: planted roofs menahan sekitar 60 persen hujan pada badai rata-rata. 60% > 50%.

questions.prompt: Owners who received tax reductions were happier with their roof gardens than other owners.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf E membahas keringanan pajak, tetapi kepuasan komparatif pemilik tidak dibahas.

questions.prompt: Most of the volunteers at the roof farms were retired people.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf F menyebut relawan, tetapi tidak merinci proporsi usia atau status pensiun.

questions.prompt: Pilih DUA manfaat rooftop farming yang menurut peneliti paling kuat didukung oleh bukti mereka.
options: Feeding most of the city's population
Lowering the tax paid by building owners
Increasing the value of buildings built before the 1970s
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf G: rooftop farming 'most convincing as a way of cooling buildings and managing rainwater'.

questions.prompt: Pada paragraf mana (A-G) informasi berikut ditemukan?

left: A comparison of the cost of strengthening a roof with the cost of the garden itself
A reason to be careful about the opinions of volunteers
A suggestion about how long future research should last
Figures showing the temperature difference between two kinds of roof

questions.explanation_id: Biaya perkuatan di E; opini relawan di F; saran lama penelitian di G; angka suhu di B.

questions.prompt: Apa yang dikumpulkan oleh farm yang lebih baru pada musim dingin untuk dipakai pada musim panas? (Maksimal TIGA kata)
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf D: 'tanks that collect rainwater in winter and release it slowly in summer'.

questions.prompt: Siswa sekolah dasar mengunjungi salah satu atap setiap bulan untuk belajar tentang apa? (Maksimal TIGA kata)
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf F: 'to learn how vegetables grow'.

questions.prompt: The maximum temperature recorded on bare concrete roofs exceeded 60 degrees Celsius.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf B menyatakan 'bare roofs reached as high as 62 degrees', yang berarti melebihi 60 derajat Celcius.

questions.prompt: The research project observed the rooftop gardens continuously for a decade.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf B menyebut penelitian berlangsung 'over three summers', sedangkan 10 tahun di Paragraf G merupakan rekomendasi penelitian lanjutan di masa depan.

questions.prompt: Urban rooftop agriculture has the capacity to replace traditional rural farming entirely.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf C menegaskan rooftop farming tidak dimaksudkan menggantikan pertanian pedesaan dan tidak dapat memberi makan seluruh kota.

questions.prompt: During typical rainfall events, vegetated roofs absorb the majority of the precipitation.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf D: 'absorbed approximately 60 percent of rainfall'. 60 persen merupakan mayoritas.

questions.prompt: Building owners in the municipal tax incentive program experienced fewer leaks than non-participants.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf E membahas insentif pajak dan kebocoran secara terpisah, namun perbandingan frekuensi kebocoran antar kelompok tidak disebutkan.

questions.prompt: Volunteers were paid an hourly stipend for participating in community garden maintenance.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf F membahas keterlibatan relawan tanpa menyebutkan adanya pembayaran uang saku.

questions.prompt: Pilih DUA dampak positif lingkungan dari vegetasi atap yang divalidasi oleh data penelitian.
options: Complete self-sufficiency in urban grain supply
questions.explanation_id: Bukti empiris paling kuat dalam teks adalah pendinginan gedung dan retensi air hujan.

questions.prompt: Di paragraf manakah (A-G) poin-poin berikut disebutkan?

left: Structural engineering challenges for older rooftops
Social and educational benefits for community members
Recommended timeline for long-term ecological evaluation
Specific heat absorption differences across roof surfaces

questions.explanation_id: Tantangan struktur di E; manfaat sosial di F; rekomendasi timeline di G; data penyerapan panas di B.

questions.prompt: Material apa yang ditampung dalam tangki penyimpanan khusus saat musim dingin? (Maksimal DUA kata)
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf D menyebut penampungan 'rainwater' dalam tangki.

questions.prompt: Berapa tahun usia kebun atap tertua yang dianalisis dalam studi tersebut? (Maksimal DUA kata)
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf G mencatat bahwa farm tertua baru berusia 'five years'.

questions.prompt: Roofs covered with vegetation maintained significantly lower temperatures during peak heat periods.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf B: planted roofs sekitar 34 derajat dibandingkan 62 derajat pada bare roofs.

questions.prompt: Data collection for surface temperatures was conducted over five consecutive calendar years.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf B: pengukuran dilakukan 'over three summers', bukan 5 tahun penuh.

questions.prompt: The authors argue that commercial rooftop farms will meet total urban dietary requirements.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf C menyatakan tidak ada peneliti yang beranggapan atap bisa memberi makan seluruh kota.

questions.prompt: Approximately sixty percent of stormwater was successfully retained by the green roofs.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf D menyebutkan angka retensi air 'approximately 60 percent'.

questions.prompt: Commercial property tenants preferred working under green roofs compared to conventional asphalt roofs.
questions.explanation_id: Teks tidak membahas preferensi psikologis atau kenyamanan para penyewa gedung komersial.

questions.prompt: All volunteer participants surveyed had previous formal training in horticulture.
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf F tidak memberikan informasi mengenai latar belakang pelatihan berkebun para relawan.

questions.prompt: Select TWO main advantages of rooftop farms emphasized in the conclusion of the research team.
options: Immediate doubling of structural roof life
questions.explanation_id: Dua manfaat inti yang divalidasi oleh tim peneliti adalah regulasi termal gedung dan retensi volume air badai.

questions.prompt: Match each statement to the correct paragraph (A-G):

left: Observations about volunteer enthusiasm and sampling bias
Advice for extending observation duration to ten years
Temperature measurements comparing bare and green surfaces

questions.explanation_id: Perhitungan bobot/biaya di E; bias antusiasme relawan di F; durasi 10 tahun di G; perbandingan suhu di B.

questions.prompt: What resource do the insulated storage tanks retain during winter months? (Maximum TWO words)
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf D mengonfirmasi bahwa tangki menampung 'rainwater'.

questions.prompt: Who visits the rooftop garden monthly as part of an environmental curriculum? (Maximum TWO words)
questions.explanation_id: Paragraf F menyebutkan 'primary school children' / 'schoolchildren' yang berkunjung setiap bulan.

questions.prompt: My sister _______ a teacher.
questions.explanation_id: Subjek 'my sister' tunggal orang ketiga, maka be yang tepat adalah 'is'.

questions.prompt: There are three _______ in the garden.
questions.explanation_id: 'Child' memiliki bentuk jamak tidak beraturan 'children'.

questions.prompt: _______ you like coffee?
questions.explanation_id: Pertanyaan Present Simple dengan subjek 'you' memakai 'do'.

questions.prompt: She _______ (go) to school every day.
questions.explanation_id: Subjek orang ketiga tunggal pada Present Simple: kata kerja ditambah -es, 'goes'.

questions.prompt: I have _______ umbrella. (a / an)
questions.explanation_id: 'Umbrella' diawali bunyi vokal, sehingga memakai 'an'.

questions.prompt: Pilih kata yang salah.
questions.explanation_id: Subjek 'he' membutuhkan 'doesn't', bukan 'don't'.

questions.prompt: Yesterday we _______ to the beach.
questions.explanation_id: 'Yesterday' menandakan Past Simple. V2 dari 'go' adalah 'went'.

questions.prompt: I am _______ a book at the moment.
questions.explanation_id: 'At the moment' menandakan Present Continuous: am + V-ing.

questions.prompt: This bag is _______ than that one.
questions.explanation_id: Kata sifat pendek berakhir -y membentuk komparatif dengan -ier: 'heavier'.

questions.prompt: We _______ (not / have) any milk.
questions.explanation_id: Bentuk negatif Present Simple untuk 'we': do not / don't + kata kerja dasar.

questions.prompt: There _______ some eggs in the fridge.
questions.explanation_id: 'Some eggs' jamak, sehingga 'there are'.

questions.prompt: Pilih kata yang salah.
questions.explanation_id: 'Last week' menandakan Past Simple; 'buy' harus menjadi 'bought'.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we _______ at home.
questions.explanation_id: First Conditional: if + Present Simple, will + kata kerja dasar.

questions.prompt: I have lived here _______ 2015.
questions.explanation_id: 'Since' dipakai dengan titik waktu awal (2015); 'for' dengan durasi.

questions.prompt: The man _______ lives next door is a doctor.
questions.explanation_id: Antecedent adalah orang dan relative pronoun berfungsi sebagai subjek: 'who'.

questions.prompt: She asked me where I _______ (live).
questions.explanation_id: Reported speech: kata kerja mundur satu tense, 'live' menjadi 'lived'.

questions.prompt: The window _______ (break) by the storm last night.
questions.explanation_id: Past Simple Passive: was + V3. V3 dari 'break' adalah 'broken'.

questions.prompt: Pilih kata yang salah.
questions.explanation_id: Durasi ('three years') memakai 'for', bukan 'since'.

questions.prompt: If I _______ more time, I would learn another language.
questions.explanation_id: Second Conditional: if + Past Simple, would + kata kerja dasar.

questions.prompt: By the time we arrived, the film _______.
questions.explanation_id: 'By the time' + Past Simple memerlukan Past Perfect untuk kejadian yang lebih dulu.

questions.prompt: He suggested _______ a taxi because it was late.
questions.explanation_id: 'Suggest' diikuti V-ing (atau klausa that + should).

questions.prompt: She denied _______ (steal) the money.
questions.explanation_id: 'Deny' diikuti gerund: 'stealing' atau 'having stolen'.

questions.prompt: The report, _______ was published last year, has been widely quoted.
questions.explanation_id: Non-defining relative clause untuk benda memakai 'which' (tidak boleh 'that' setelah koma).

questions.prompt: Pilih kata yang salah.
questions.explanation_id: 'Despite' tidak diikuti 'of'. Yang benar 'Despite the heavy rain' atau 'In spite of the heavy rain'.

questions.prompt: Had I known about the delay, I _______ earlier.
questions.explanation_id: Inversion Third Conditional: 'Had I known' = 'If I had known', hasilnya would have + V3.

questions.prompt: Not only _______ the exam, but she also won a prize.
questions.explanation_id: Setelah 'not only' di awal kalimat terjadi inversi subjek-auxiliary: 'did she pass'.

questions.prompt: The proposal, _______ by several experts, was eventually withdrawn.
questions.explanation_id: Participle clause pasif (past participle) menggantikan 'which was criticised'.

questions.prompt: It is essential that every student _______ (submit) the form by Friday.
questions.explanation_id: Setelah 'essential that', dipakai subjunctive (kata kerja dasar) atau 'should + kata kerja dasar'.

questions.prompt: Rarely _______ (we / see) such a dramatic improvement.
questions.explanation_id: Adverbia negatif di awal kalimat memicu inversi: 'do we see'.

questions.prompt: Pilih kata yang salah.
questions.explanation_id: 'The number of ...' bersubjek tunggal 'number', sehingga 'has risen'.

assessment_sets.title: Skip Test Modul 2.1: Complex Grammar & Sentence Combining

questions.prompt: _______ the weather was terrible, the match went ahead.
questions.explanation_id: 'Although' diikuti klausa lengkap dan menyatakan kontras.

questions.prompt: She studied very hard; _______, she failed the exam.
questions.explanation_id: Hasilnya berlawanan dengan harapan, sehingga dibutuhkan penanda kontras 'however'.

questions.prompt: _______ his injury, he completed the race.
questions.explanation_id: 'Despite' diikuti kata benda ('his injury').

questions.prompt: The woman _______ car was stolen called the police.
questions.explanation_id: Relative pronoun kepemilikan: 'whose car'.

questions.prompt: This is the office _______ I work.
questions.explanation_id: Antecedent adalah tempat dan klausa lengkap mengikuti, sehingga dipakai 'where'.

questions.prompt: The bridge _______ (build) in 1998.
questions.explanation_id: Past Simple Passive: was + V3 -> 'was built'.

questions.prompt: Pilih kata yang membuat kalimat pasif ini salah.
questions.explanation_id: Pasif future membutuhkan 'will be announced'.

questions.prompt: If I _______ you, I would accept the offer.
questions.explanation_id: Second Conditional untuk situasi imajiner memakai 'were' setelah 'if I'.

questions.prompt: If she had left earlier, she _______ the train.
questions.explanation_id: Third Conditional: if + Past Perfect, would have + V3.

questions.prompt: Susun segmen menjadi kalimat yang benar.
questions.explanation_id: Klausa 'although' diletakkan di depan dipisah koma.

questions.prompt: Pasangkan penanda wacana dengan fungsinya.
questions.explanation_id: However = kontras; therefore = hasil; moreover = penambahan; for instance = contoh.

questions.prompt: If the temperature _______ (drop) below zero, the water will freeze.
questions.explanation_id: First Conditional: if + Present Simple tunggal 'drops'.

questions.prompt: _______ the train was delayed, we arrived at the venue on schedule.
questions.explanation_id: 'Although' mengenalkan klausa kontras dengan subjek dan predikat lengkap.

questions.prompt: The experimental data was inconclusive; _______, further funding was approved.
questions.explanation_id: 'Nevertheless' menghubungkan kontras antara hasil yang meragukan dengan persetujuan dana.

questions.prompt: _______ the strict travel restrictions, the conference drew over 500 delegates.
questions.explanation_id: 'In spite of' diikuti frasa kata benda ('the strict travel restrictions').

questions.prompt: The author _______ latest monograph won the literary award gave a keynote speech.
questions.explanation_id: Kepemilikan buku karya pengarang: 'whose latest monograph'.

questions.prompt: The historical archive is an institution _______ researchers examine original manuscripts.
questions.explanation_id: Menunjukkan tempat terjadinya aktivitas penelitian: 'where researchers examine...'.

questions.prompt: The international airport _______ (open) by the prime minister in 2012.
questions.explanation_id: Past Simple Passive tunggal: 'was opened'.

questions.prompt: Pilih kata yang membuat kalimat ini salah secara tata bahasa.
questions.explanation_id: Bentuk present perfect pasif membutuhkan V3 'been transferred'.

questions.prompt: If our department _______ a larger budget, we would recruit additional specialists.
questions.explanation_id: Second conditional untuk kondisi hipotesis masa kini: if + Past Simple ('had').

questions.prompt: Had the security alarm sounded, the residents _______ the building immediately.
questions.explanation_id: Third conditional inversion: Had + S + V3 berpasangan dengan would have + V3.

questions.prompt: Susun segmen menjadi kalimat kohesif akademik.
segments: gained broad support across the region.
questions.explanation_id: Prepositional phrase 'Despite...' mengawali kalimat dan diikuti klausa inti.

questions.prompt: Pasangkan konjungsi logis berikut dengan relasi maknanya.
questions.explanation_id: On the contrary = pertentangan; as a consequence = akibat; furthermore = penguatan; namely = spesifikasi nama.

questions.prompt: If global carbon emissions _______ (continue) to climb, sea levels will rise significantly.
questions.explanation_id: First conditional: if + Present Simple jamak ('continue').

questions.prompt: _______ the economic downturn was severe, the technology sector continued to expand.
questions.explanation_id: 'Even though' mengenalkan klausa kontras konsesi dengan klausa lengkap.

questions.prompt: The team lacked access to cutting-edge equipment; _______, their findings were remarkably accurate.
questions.explanation_id: Penanda kontras 'nonetheless' menghubungkan keterbatasan alat dengan akurasi tinggi.

questions.prompt: _______ intense competition in the domestic market, the startup achieved profitability.
questions.explanation_id: 'Despite' diikuti oleh noun phrase 'intense competition...''.

questions.prompt: The scientist _______ hypothesis revolutionized astrophysics was honored internationally.
questions.explanation_id: Kepemilikan hipotesis ilmiah: 'whose hypothesis'.

questions.prompt: The research laboratory is a sterile environment _______ sensitive genetic experiments are performed.
questions.explanation_id: Relative adverb tempat: 'where sensitive genetic experiments are performed'.

questions.prompt: The new environmental legislation _______ (enact) by parliament earlier this year.
questions.explanation_id: Past Simple Passive: 'was enacted'.

questions.prompt: Pilih kata yang membuat kalimat pasif modal ini salah.
questions.explanation_id: Pasif modal: must + be + V3 -> 'be disposed'.

questions.prompt: If the municipal council _______ more bus routes, fewer commuters would drive cars.
questions.explanation_id: Second conditional: if + Past Simple ('provided') berpasangan dengan would + bare verb.

questions.prompt: If the emergency brakes had failed, the locomotive _______ off the tracks.
questions.explanation_id: Third conditional: if + Past Perfect, would have + V3.

questions.prompt: Susun segmen menjadi kalimat pasif proses yang efektif.
segments: can be damaged by sediment buildup.
questions.explanation_id: Klausa kondisional 'Unless...' diletakkan di depan lalu diikuti subjek pasif.

questions.prompt: Pasangkan kata transisi berikut dengan fungsi wacananya.
questions.explanation_id: In contrast = perbedaan; hence = konsekuensi logis; likewise = kemiripan ide; specifically = contoh spesifik.

questions.prompt: If the atmospheric pressure _______ (fall) rapidly, a severe storm is likely to develop.
questions.explanation_id: First conditional: if + Present Simple tunggal 'falls'.

assessment_sets.title: Boss Tier 1 - Reading
assessment_sets.reading_passage_markdown:
## A Saturday at Green Lane Market

Green Lane Market opens every Saturday morning in the car park behind the town library. It starts at eight o'clock and closes at two in the afternoon. About sixty small stalls sell fruit, vegetables, bread, cheese, flowers and second-hand books. Most of the sellers live within thirty kilometres of the town, and many of them have been coming to the market for more than ten years.

Maya Santos has sold vegetables at the market for six years. She and her husband have a small farm outside the town. On Friday evening they pick the vegetables, and early on Saturday morning they drive to the market in an old van. "I like to talk to the customers," Maya says. "People ask me how to cook a vegetable they have never tried, and I tell them. It makes the work more interesting."

The busiest time is between ten and twelve o'clock. Families walk slowly between the stalls, children try small pieces of cheese, and a young man plays the guitar near the entrance. There is no entrance fee, but the sellers pay the town council eight pounds each week for their place. If it rains heavily, the market stays open, but fewer people come, and some sellers go home early.

Last year the town council asked visitors what they would like to change. Most people said they were happy with the market, but about a third complained about the lack of parking. As a result, the council made an agreement with the primary school across the road: from this spring, visitors can leave their cars in the school car park, which is free on Saturdays. Some people also asked for a cafe, and the council is now planning one. It will not open until next year.

Not everyone buys food. Some visitors come only to listen to the music or to meet friends. A retired teacher, Mr Chen, comes every week to buy flowers for his kitchen table, and then he drinks a cup of tea on a bench by the old fountain. "It is the best part of my week," he says. "I always know I will see someone I know."
